help.body.command: Both sides gain 1 Command Point. Units that are battle-shocked, or at or below half strength, take a battle-shock test.
help.body.movement: Select one of your units, then drag it. A unit may move up to its Move value, or Advance (Move plus a D6 roll, and it cannot charge normally). Units engaged within 2" may only Fall back. Units must end in coherency (within 2" horizontally of another model) and may not end within 2" of enemies.
help.body.shooting: Select a unit, then tap an enemy it can see. The odds panel shows exact hit, wound and save chances before you fire. Each unit shoots once.
help.body.charge: Declare a charge with a unit within 12" of an enemy. The 2D6 roll sets how far it may move. It must end engaged with every target and not engaged with anything else.
help.body.fight_pile_in: Units in or near melee may move up to 3" toward the nearest enemy before fighting.
help.body.fight_fight: Units that charged fight first. Then players alternate choosing a unit that is engaged. Select it, tap an enemy and fight.
help.body.fight_consolidate: Units may consolidate up to 3" to stay engaged or move toward an objective.

howto.title: How to play
howto.aim.title: The aim
howto.aim.body: Two armies fight over objectives for five rounds. Hold objectives to score victory points. The higher score wins, and wiping out the other side ends the battle early.
howto.turn.title: A round
howto.turn.body: Each round you and the AI take a turn each, and the first-turn roll-off decides who goes first. A turn runs through five phases in a fixed order, and the bar at the top shows where you are.
howto.phases.title: The five phases
howto.phases.body:
Command: both sides gain a point and struggling units are tested.
Movement: drag each unit, or hold it still.
Shooting: pick a unit, tap a target and read the odds before you fire.
Charge: roll to rush a nearby enemy.
Fight: move in, take turns picking units to attack, then move again.
The Rules button in the Orders tab explains the phase you are in.
howto.tools.title: Tools
howto.tools.body:
Ruler: turn it on and drag across the board to measure in inches.
Weapon rings: tap a weapon on the Unit tab to see how far it reaches.
Units tab: every unit, with what is left of it and whether it has acted.
Undo move: take back your last move, if nothing else has happened since. Advances cannot be undone.
The game saves at the start of each of your turns, so you can Continue later.
howto.controls.title: Controls
howto.controls.body: Touch or mouse: tap to select, drag to move, pinch or scroll to zoom. Keyboard and gamepad lists are in Settings, under Controls.
strat.command_reroll.name: Command Re-roll
strat.command_reroll.effect: Re-roll an Advance or charge roll, or one die of a failed battle-shock roll.
strat.command_reroll.when: Just after your unit makes one of those rolls.
strat.epic_challenge.name: Epic Challenge
strat.epic_challenge.effect: A CHARACTER's melee weapons gain Precision this phase.
strat.epic_challenge.when: When your CHARACTER unit is chosen to fight.
strat.insane_bravery.name: Insane Bravery
strat.insane_bravery.effect: The unit passes its battle-shock roll. Once per battle.
strat.insane_bravery.when: Just before a battle-shock roll, for a unit that is not shocked.
strat.explosives.name: Explosives
strat.explosives.effect: Roll six dice at an enemy within 8": each 4+ is a mortal wound.
strat.explosives.when: Your Shooting phase, with a unit that has the keyword.
strat.crushing_impact.name: Crushing Impact
strat.crushing_impact.effect: Roll T dice: each 1 hurts you, each 5+ hurts them, at most 6.
strat.crushing_impact.when: Just after your MONSTER or VEHICLE ends a charge move.
strat.rapid_ingress.name: Rapid Ingress
strat.rapid_ingress.effect: A unit in reserve arrives at the end of the enemy move.
strat.rapid_ingress.when: End of the opponent's Movement phase.
strat.fire_overwatch.name: Fire Overwatch
strat.fire_overwatch.effect: Shoot a visible enemy within 24", hitting only on 6s.
strat.fire_overwatch.when: End of the opponent's Movement phase.
strat.smokescreen.name: Smokescreen
strat.smokescreen.effect: Attacks on a SMOKE unit count as into cover this phase.
strat.smokescreen.when: Start of the opponent's Shooting phase.
strat.heroic_intervention.name: Heroic Intervention
strat.heroic_intervention.effect: Charge an enemy that just charged. The unit moves by itself.
strat.heroic_intervention.when: End of the opponent's Charge phase.
strat.counteroffensive.name: Counteroffensive
strat.counteroffensive.effect: The unit fights next, with Fights First.
strat.counteroffensive.when: Just after an enemy unit fights in the opponent's turn.

help.body.deployment: Players take turns placing one unit, starting with the Defender. Tap a unit in the tray, drag it inside your highlighted zone, then place it. Every model must be wholly inside the zone, in coherency, off other models and out of dense terrain. When all units are down, a roll-off decides who takes the first turn.

howto.deploy.title: Before round 1
howto.deploy.body: You and the opponent take turns placing units in your own zones. Tap a unit in the tray, drag it into your highlighted zone, then place it. Auto-deploy remaining does the rest for you. A roll-off then decides who goes first.
howto.stratagems.title: Stratagems
howto.stratagems.body: Both sides gain 1 Command Point (CP) in every Command phase. Spend CP on stratagems, listed on the Strat tab with what each does and why it's greyed. You can use each stratagem once a phase and target a unit once a phase, and a battle-shocked unit can't be targeted. When you can respond in the opponent's turn the game stops and asks, with Use or Pass and no timer. You can turn this off in Settings, under Gameplay.
